The generator uses real, freshly generated ML-DSA agent/machine keys. It writes
one X0A4 announcement, one base advert plus X0CR trailer, and one watermark.
The signed timestamp is 2000000000000 ms; no certificate or secret key is stored.
The generator uses create_new and refuses to overwrite this fixture.
The decoder test re-verifies all signatures at that explicit timestamp.

This is the INITIAL, UNRELEASED encoder fixture. No released binary implements
X0PEV1 yet. It is not represented as a v0.45 release artifact. Keep this fixture
unchanged when this layout releases; add actual release-artifact provenance at
that gate, as ADR 0085 requires. Accepted ADR files have not been edited.
